name: cprospect-fit-score
description: Lead enrichment build phase 1 (prds/lead-enrichment/design.md § 4, rulings E2, E13): the free pass writes a fit score, its gate result and its three signals on the lead. Additive only. None of these fields may be Read-only: the application writes them (CLAUDE.md Gotchas, ruling 40). Handoff: lead-fit-score-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: fitScore
fields.label: Fit score
fields.tooltipText: 0 to 100, written by the free pass: how likely this lead is to be a fit under ruling 10. 0 when the lead is out of area. Never edit by hand; the next pass overwrites it.

fields.name: fitGate
fields.label: Service area
fields.tooltipText: The free pass's service-area gate (ruling E13). Out of area means the location is confirmed outside the chapter's counties; Location unknown means the only address is a registered agent's.

fields.name: fitCounty
fields.label: County
fields.tooltipText: The county the free pass placed this lead in, from its postal code. Empty when the location is unknown.

fields.name: fitOperating
fields.label: Fit: operating business
fields.tooltipText: 0 to 100: how strongly the lead reads as a business being started to run, rather than a holding company, a property company or a serial filer's entity.

fields.name: fitSegment
fields.label: Fit: segment
fields.tooltipText: 0 to 100: how well the industry the lead suggests matches the chapter's segment list. 50 for every lead until the list exists.

fields.name: fitFindability
fields.label: Fit: findability
fields.tooltipText: 0 to 100: whether a website or email was found and verified for this lead (ruling E12).

fields.name: fitReasons
fields.label: Fit reasons
fields.tooltipText: Why the free pass scored this lead as it did, one line per reason, written by the free pass.

fields.name: fitRuleVersion
fields.label: Fit rule version
fields.tooltipText: The version of the scoring rules that produced this score. A newer version rescores the lead.
